quote: Introducing Claude Opus 5 \ Anthropic, dated "Jul 24, 2026": "Claude Opus 5 is available today." Later on the page: "Claude Opus 5 is available today on all platforms."
note: Anthropic's own launch post (anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5) carries a Jul 24, 2026 date line and says the model is available today on all platforms. The quote is from a summarizing WebFetch, not a raw copy of the page, so the exact wording of the date line should be checked against the page. Secondary sources disagree by a day: one says Jul 25, 2026 Japan time, which looks like a time-zone difference; the Anthropic date line is used here. No preview or waitlist was found. Lab and kind notes are correct. Claude Opus 5.5 (reported 2026-09-22) is a later model and is not the subject of this record; its only sources are secondary and conflicting, so it is not relied on here.
